objective: Close the sequential-selection and support/value interaction gaps identified after COUNT-PRODUCTION-SHARED-ABLATIONS-50-001 without changing K=32, the canonical recovery contract, historical evidence, or protected-data boundary.

inputs.development_scope: same 50 exposed HEST slices; no protected confirmation data

bucket_scan.b32_edges: insert floor midpoint between adjacent B16 edges, retaining endpoints and all B16 edges
bucket_scan.b64_stop_rule: run only if B32 pooled full bytes are >0.05% below B16 and the B32 incremental graph/model cost is smaller than its support-stream saving versus B16
bucket_scan.selection: minimum pooled full physical bytes; <=0.05% tie selects smaller B

support_value_joint.initial_grid: final bucket candidate crossed with M_s in {4,6,8}; M6 is reused where byte-identical
support_value_joint.extension: if B32 is selected, repeat M_s={4,6,8} at B32; otherwise use B16
support_value_joint.support_graph: M_s<=6 reuses production graph prefix; M_s>6 stores and pays only the incremental graph tail

value_context_scan.extension: test M_v=16 only if M_v=12 is the boundary winner by >0.05% versus M_v=6
value_context_scan.graph: M_v<=6 reuses shared graph prefix; M_v>6 stores and pays incremental value graph tail
value_context_scan.reuse_audit: M_v=0 and M_v=6 require member-level semantic comparison to existing value-context anchors

pre_registration.threshold_scan: do not run unless final M_v scan leaves a >0.05% pooled context gain that cannot be attributed to graph/model cost; otherwise classify existing thresholds as design constants

acceptance_criteria: All executed arms use real archives, fresh archive-only decoding, exact recovery and physical ledgers
B32 and any conditional B64 decision are frozen before execution of that arm
Support/value joint grid is reported without calling sequential single-variable minima jointly optimal
All failures and retries are retained
Independent read-only audit and at least three fresh-process reproductions pass
Existing 1000-sample B8 result remains headline unless the full 1000-sample Shared method is rerun; a new development candidate is not relabeled as the old production result
METHOD_COVERAGE_AUDIT, RESULT, PAPER_TABLES and frozen-config decision are updated
forbidden_changes: modify prior evidence or source data
change K=32 or canonical recovery semantics
result: K32 Shared B32/M_s=6/M_v=6 is a development candidate; historical 1000-sample B8 remains headline.
